name: non_slack_dispatches_while_slack_down
why: The Slack health gate must be PER TARGET. With Slack unreachable, a quest whose watches are all email must still dispatch, while a Slack-only quest is gated with its watermark untouched so it retries next tick. The defect this pins: the gate was computed per target but APPLIED globally, so the first Slack-needing target exited the whole tick and stalled email/Jira/schedule work that did not depend on Slack. Every Slack hiccup then cost every non-Slack target a tick, which adds up fast. (A MIXED quest is still gated as a whole, since dispatch granularity is the target, and that is correct.)
